jobs.prompt: A full-bleed illustration that fills the entire frame edge to edge, with no border, no margin and no paper edge. A dark fantasy storybook painting, painted by hand with rough gouache and oil over a bold black ink drawing: gritty textured brushwork, ink contours of varied weight, realistic proportions, grim and serious, dramatic chiaroscuro, heavy black shadows, a muted desaturated palette of slate, umber and rust. Night, long ago. Seen from high on the rim of a vast deep cut in a hillside: a long column of soldiers in rust-red cloaks and dull bronze helmets winds down a narrow path along the cut's wall carrying torches, the small figures growing smaller as they go down into the dark; one carries a standard topped with VII. At the very bottom of the cut, far below, a colossal pale curved surface rises out of the earth: a low smooth ivory-white hump ridged with great ribs, larger than the cut itself, with no head, no eyes, no limbs; nothing else of it is visible. In the foreground at the top of the frame, two soldiers seen from behind hold torches high. Torch smoke drifts and sparks fall into the dark. The orange torchlight is the only strong color; everything else is night.

jobs.prompt: A full-bleed illustration that fills the entire frame edge to edge, with no border, no margin and no paper edge. A dark fantasy storybook painting, painted by hand with rough gouache and oil over a bold black ink drawing: gritty textured brushwork, ink contours of varied weight, realistic proportions, grim and serious, dramatic chiaroscuro, heavy black shadows, a muted desaturated palette of slate, umber and rust. Night, hard frost on a field beside a road. A dead man stands upright, slack and blank-faced, arms hanging, his skin gray; a dull orange glow shines from inside him, out through his open mouth, his empty eye sockets and the wounds in his chest. An old watchman with a gray beard, in a slate blue-gray hooded cloak, a round wooden shield on his left arm, drives a long spear into the dead man's chest; from the wound the orange light pours out and falls onto the frost as a scatter of small glowing orange stones. Behind them another body lies dark and empty on the frost. The watchman's breath smokes in the cold; the dead man breathes nothing. Small orange embers glint in the dark soil. The orange light is the only strong color; the rest is cold night and frost.

A dark fantasy storybook painting, painted by hand with rough gouache and oil over a bold black ink drawing: gritty textured brushwork, ink contours of varied weight, realistic proportions, grim and serious, dramatic chiaroscuro, heavy black shadows, a muted desaturated palette of slate, umber and rust. Dusk, the last light: a deep blue sky over a dull rose band low on the horizon. A small camp beside a dirt road: a campfire burning high, a log, a bedroll unrolled with its blanket still folded on it, a pack. A lone traveler sits by the fire, seen from behind, in a long hooded coat of dark weathered wool with the deep hood up, reading a folded letter, a small flask on a cord wound round one gloved wrist. Far up the road, the tiny warm lamps of a distant waystation, one lamp higher than the rest. Low among the dark trees to the right, by unseen water, three small points of cold pale-blue light. The firelight is warm orange-gold; the dark around it is blue.
